description.narrative:
The government through the Ministry of Labour's Department of Employment (DOE) and Department of Skills Development (DSD) has increased capacity to design and implement gender-responsive employment services and labour market programmes for an inclusive and sustainable COVID-19 recovery, with a particular focus on youth.
The Ministry of Labour has strengthened its systems and delivery channels for employment services by developing a virtual job fair modality, leveraging e-employment services and partnerships with the Ministry of Social Development and Human Security, Employers' Confederation of Thailand, and workers' organization in delivering tailored services. The ILO implemented the "Young Futuremakers Thailand – Promoting youth employability" project"to support disadvantaged youth in particular young women and young persons with disabilities, through the provision of demand-led technical skills training, employability training, career guidance and job placements.
ILO provided technical support to improve employment-related knowledge and skills of disadvantaged young women and young persons with disabilities. ILO supported DSD in identifying relevant training curricula for adaptation to the needs of young people. ILO adapted and piloted entrepreneurial awareness and soft skills training curricula for youth based on the ILO Ready for Business curriculum and conceptualized a peer-to-peer modality for implementation. ILO supported the adaptation of the Data Analytics and Visualization (DAV) course to the needs of youth, including young women and young persons with disabilities, and developed a pilot online module of the DAV course.
ILO provided technical support to strengthen institutional resources and capacities to provide tailored skills training and employment services. ILO provided technical support to the DOE to organize an online job fair in Rayong which leveraged the government's Smart Job Center website in combination with the Line application to provide 2,052 jobseekers and 46 employers a platform to post around 3,681 job vacancies. ILO contributed to the development and application of a guidance tool for greening TVET in collaboration with DSD. ILO supported the engagement of employers' and workers' organizations on inclusive workplaces and practices to support the employment of excluded young people. ILO conducted a situation analysis to analyse the labour market situation of youth and assess employment opportunities and needs of employers. Building on the situation analysis, ILO organized a technical workshop with key stakeholders to validate the findings.
